notes.mcnair-hall: Pinned on OSM's East McNair Hall (way/129969079); OSM maps McNair as East and West McNair, which the name rule can't pick between. Michigan Tech's campus map (mtu.edu/map) shows McNair Hall here, east of Hillside Place.
notes.memorial-union-building: The Memorial Union Building holds the MUB Commons food court, Michigan Tech's dining spot outside the residence halls (mtu.edu/dining); its name doesn't say dining.
notes.little-huskies-child-development-center: Childcare (OSM amenity=childcare), not somewhere classes happen.
notes.ae-seaman-mineral-museum: The A. E. Seaman Mineral Museum (OSM tourism=museum), not a class building.
notes.nordic-waxing-center: A ski-waxing building at the Tech Trails, an outbuilding rather than a class building.
notes.emergency-services: Campus emergency-services building, not somewhere classes happen.
notes.alumni-house: Alumni House (mtu.edu/map), not somewhere classes happen.
notes.administration-building: The Administration Building at 1400 Townsend Drive (mtu.edu/map), offices rather than classrooms.
notes.daniell-heights-community-center: The community centre of the Daniell Heights apartments (OSM amenity=community_centre), a housing amenity rather than a class building.
notes.outdoor-adventure-program: Outdoor Adventure Program gear rental (OSM description 'Outdoor gear rentals and area information'), not a class building.
